ftb.guhs_band.title: &dSweet Chonkies Together
ftb.guhs_band.sub: Hearts, houses, chores and faves. Nyeg!
ftb.guhs_band.section.guhkamer: The Guh Room in Your Guhbelly
ftb.guhs_band.q.intro_guhs_band.title: How Do You Get Here?
ftb.guhs_band.q.intro_guhs_band.desc:
This chapter comes after &dA Chonky Buddy&r in &dGuhs & Basics&r: as soon as you've tamed a guh, your &dheart meter&r starts ticking.

Give your guh snacks, pet it (a short right-click: every pet is a cuddly moment) and give it a big &dCuddle&r (hold right-click: the menu). That way you become &dsweet chonkies together&r, then &dmega sweet chonkies together&r and finally &6soulguh bff 5evr <3&r. Hearts never go down!

Build a &dGuh House&r (a little house shaped like a guh head): your guhs and buddies live there, sleep there at night and do chores during the day. Your &dGuhdex&r (My Guhs tab) has every guh's diary.

Nothing is locked: every quest ticks itself off as soon as you've done it, even if you did it before. The headings show what logically comes next. Tick this off and get chonking!
ftb.guhs_band.q.band_aaien.title: Pat Pat
ftb.guhs_band.q.band_aaien.desc: Give your tame guh a quick tap with right-click: a pet! It squishes flat with happiness, pushes its little head against your hand and hearts pop up. Every pet is worth a &dheart&r (but not endlessly many per day, or it gets spoiled, nyeg). Sitting down or standing up is in the guh menu: hold right-click.
ftb.guhs_band.q.band_voeren.title: A Snack for Your Guh
ftb.guhs_band.q.band_voeren.desc: Give your own guh a little snack: a cupcake, a macaron, an ice cream, a cookie, sweet berries... It munches it up and you both get &dhearts&r. Maybe you'll even find its favorite snack!
ftb.guhs_band.q.band_knuffel.title: A Big Cuddle
ftb.guhs_band.q.band_knuffel.desc: Hold right-click on your guh and pick &dCuddle!&r. A big chonky cuddle is worth lots of hearts. Afterwards your guh needs a moment to recover: it's all warm and fuzzy.
ftb.guhs_band.q.band_eerste_hartjes.desc: Collect &d100 hearts&r with a guh: then you're &dsweet chonkies together&r! You get hearts from petting, feeding, cuddling and just being together (a minute nearby = a heart). They never go down!
ftb.guhs_band.q.band_mega.title: Mega Sweet Chonkies
ftb.guhs_band.q.band_mega.desc: Reach &d600 hearts&r with a guh: &dmega sweet chonkies together&r. Do chores, play together and discover its faves: that's the fastest way.
ftb.guhs_band.q.band_zielsguh.title: Soulguh bff 5evr <3
ftb.guhs_band.q.band_zielsguh.desc: &62000 hearts&r: you're &6soulguh bff 5evr <3&r. Forever, for real. Your guh gets a sparkly heart next to its name. WAHOOG!
ftb.guhs_band.q.band_dagboekje.title: The Diary
ftb.guhs_band.q.band_dagboekje.desc: Hold right-click on your guh and pick &dDiary&r (or look in your &dGuhdex&r under My Guhs). It has its hearts, faves, buddies, where it is, its firsts and the did-you-knows it writes down itself.
ftb.guhs_band.q.huisje_bouwen.title: A House with Ears
ftb.guhs_band.q.huisje_bouwen.desc: A &dGuh House&r is a little house shaped like a guh head: the ears are the roof, the eyes are the windows and the snoot is the door! You get your first one from the &6Carpenter Guh&r (at the building site on the edge of every Snuggledale town). With his &6building booklet&r in your crafting table you can make more yourself: pink wool, a cheese nibble, planks and a door.
ftb.guhs_band.q.huisje_bewoner.title: Welcome Home!
ftb.guhs_band.q.huisje_bewoner.desc: Right-click your house and pick &dNew Resident&r (or right-click the house while carrying a guh or a buddy). Guhs, squeaksqueak mice, Shelly and Poopshelly can all live there. The house is their home now: they stay nearby.
ftb.guhs_band.q.huisje_slapen.title: Sleep Tight, Guh
ftb.guhs_band.q.huisje_slapen.desc: At night your residents walk in through the snoot door and sleep in their house (just look at the zzz by the windows). In the morning they come back out, yawning. Wait one night and see!
ftb.guhs_band.q.huisje_koepel.title: Show the Chore Area
ftb.guhs_band.q.huisje_koepel.desc: In the house screen you can turn on &9show the chore area&r: a blue dome over the area where your residents wander, do chores and play. That way you know exactly where your gardens and chests should go.
ftb.guhs_band.q.huisje_medium.title: A House with Flower Boxes
ftb.guhs_band.q.huisje_medium.desc: Turn a small house into a &dmedium&r Guh House (with a block of cheese nibbles and the Carpenter Guh's building booklet): room for five residents, and flower boxes under the eyes!
ftb.guhs_band.q.huisje_groot.title: Villa Wahoog
ftb.guhs_band.q.huisje_groot.desc: The biggest &dGuh House&r: room for eight chonky residents, with a little chimney and a bow on the ear. You need a guh crystal for it (and the Carpenter Guh's building booklet).
ftb.guhs_band.q.huisje_vol.title: Full Is Full, Nyeg!
ftb.guhs_band.q.huisje_vol.desc: Fill a Guh House all the way up with residents. So many sweet chonkies under one roof!
ftb.guhs_band.q.klusjes_lampje.title: A Lamp with Ears
ftb.guhs_band.q.klusjes_lampje.desc: Make a few &dguh lamps&r (pink wool, glass, a torch and a cheese nibble). Right-click turns them on or off, but residents with the &eLights&r chore do that by themselves in the evening and morning!
ftb.guhs_band.q.klusjes_opgraven.title: Digger Guh
ftb.guhs_band.q.klusjes_opgraven.desc: Have a resident of your Guh House &edig up cheese nibbles&r: it digs in grass, dirt or sand in the chore area. Put a chest next to the house, that's where the loot goes. Squeaksqueak mice love to dig along too!
ftb.guhs_band.q.klusjes_farmen.title: Old McGuh Had a Farm
ftb.guhs_band.q.klusjes_farmen.desc: Plant wheat, carrots, cheese nibble plants or guh gardens by the house. Residents with the &eFarming&r chore harvest everything that's ripe and replant it right away. Thirsty gardens get watered too!
ftb.guhs_band.q.klusjes_opruimen.title: Neat and Tidy
ftb.guhs_band.q.klusjes_opruimen.desc: Stuff lying around all over the place by the house? The &eTidy Up&r chore picks it up and takes it to the chest. Do put down a chest (or Bank Guh), or your guh won't know where it goes, nyeg.
ftb.guhs_band.q.klusjes_bank.title: A Place for Everything
ftb.guhs_band.q.klusjes_bank.desc: Put a &dBank Guh&r in your house's chore area. Everything your residents collect then gets neatly sorted into the Bank Guh, and with Tidy Up so does whatever's still in the chest. Borrowed stuff always stays in the chest.
ftb.guhs_band.q.klusjes_dieren.title: Sweet Pet Sitter
ftb.guhs_band.q.klusjes_dieren.desc: Keep guh lambs, nibble chicks or a guh cow by the house. The &eAnimals & Bees&r chore pets and feeds them (put nibble feed in the chest), picks up wool and eggs, milks the guh cow (with empty bottles from the chest) and harvests full nibble hives.
ftb.guhs_band.q.klusjes_bakken.title: Guh the Baker
ftb.guhs_band.q.klusjes_bakken.desc: Put a &dguh windmill&r and a &dnibble oven&r by the house. With nibble grain in the chest your guh grinds flour, and when the chest has everything for a recipe, it bakes you goodies. With nibble flour you get twice as much!
ftb.guhs_band.q.klusjes_vissen.title: Gone Fishin'
ftb.guhs_band.q.klusjes_vissen.desc: Dig a little pond (at least 3 water blocks) in the chore area. Residents with the &eFishing&r chore catch guhfish and &dseashells&r. Shelly and Poopshelly fish along too!
ftb.guhs_band.q.klusjes_zeldzaam.title: Look What I Found!
ftb.guhs_band.q.klusjes_zeldzaam.desc: Every now and then a resident digs or fishes up something &6rare&r: a guh crystal, fried cheese nibbles, even a Golden Guhfish... You'll hear it right away, because it's super happy about it too. WAHOOG!
ftb.guhs_band.q.klusjes_waken.title: Watchguh
ftb.guhs_band.q.klusjes_waken.desc: Residents with the &eWatch & Warn&r chore squeak when a Mika or monster comes near the house, run to you and very gently push Mikas away. They never fight: guhs are always sweet!
ftb.guhs_band.q.klusjes_plukken.title: Berry Picker
ftb.guhs_band.q.klusjes_plukken.desc: Nibbleberries, sweet berries or flowers by the house? The &ePicking&r chore picks them for you (the bushes and flowers stay put): at a flower your guh brings home a flower of a random kind, most often a pink guh flower.
ftb.guhs_band.q.klusjes_lampjes.title: Lights On
ftb.guhs_band.q.klusjes_lampjes.desc: Put guh lamps (or candles) around your house. When evening comes, a resident turns them on, and in the morning off again, with a yawn.
ftb.guhs_band.q.klusjes_oppas.title: Babysitter Guh
ftb.guhs_band.q.klusjes_oppas.desc: Let squeaksqueak mice, Shelly or Poopshelly potter around the house: the &eSitting&r chore cuddles and feeds them. A hurt guh gets a snack from the chest from another guh and is all better again.
ftb.guhs_band.q.klusjes_alle.title: Chore Champion
ftb.guhs_band.q.klusjes_alle.desc: Have your residents do &6all ten&r chores. In the house screen you can see which chores each resident does (and what's needed for them). What hard workers, and what chonks!
ftb.guhs_band.q.speelgoed_knabbelbal.des: Make a &dnibble ball&r: pink wool with a cheese nibble inside. Put it down and watch: your guhs push it around with their snoots until the nibble rolls out... and then: nom nom! Empty? Right-click with a cheese nibble to fill it again.
ftb.guhs_band.q.speelgoed_schop.title: Kick the Ball
ftb.guhs_band.q.speelgoed_schop.desc: Kick the nibble ball away with a &dleft-click&r. Your guhs nearby chase after it right away. First one to push the nibble out wins!
ftb.guhs_band.q.speelgoed_glijbaantje.de: Build a &dguh slide&r (a climbing frame with guh ears and a shiny slide). Guhs climb up, slide down and run back for another go. Right-click to slide yourself!
ftb.guhs_band.q.speelgoed_tunnel.title: Fluffy Tunnel
ftb.guhs_band.q.speelgoed_tunnel.desc: Make &dfluffy tunnels&r and link them up: straight bits, bends, crossings. Every entrance is a guh snoot with ears. Guhs run through them and hide inside!
ftb.guhs_band.q.speelgoed_verstop.title: Hide-and-Seek
ftb.guhs_band.q.speelgoed_verstop.desc: Is a guh hiding in the tunnel (you can hear it giggling)? &dKnock&r on it with a right-click: found you! A tame mousie of yours joins the search too, squeak squeak.
ftb.guhs_band.q.speelgoed_wip.title: Up and Down
ftb.guhs_band.q.speelgoed_wip.desc: Build a &dguh seesaw&r. Two guhs together have the most fun; one on its own just bobs a little. Sneak and right-click to hop on yourself.
ftb.guhs_band.q.speelgoed_schommel.title: Swinging
ftb.guhs_band.q.speelgoed_schommel.desc: Build a &dguh swing&r, with a guh head on the beam. A guh swings on it all by itself.
ftb.guhs_band.q.speelgoed_duw.title: Higher, Higher!
ftb.guhs_band.q.speelgoed_duw.desc: Is a guh on the swing or the seesaw? Give it a &dlittle push&r (right-click): higher! Your own guh gets hearts from it.
ftb.guhs_band.q.speelgoed_eerste.title: Playtime!
ftb.guhs_band.q.speelgoed_eerste.desc: Put toys down near your guhs. When a player is nearby, they start playing on their own; residents of a &dGuh House&r also play with toys around their house. Playing gives &dhearts&r!
ftb.guhs_band.q.speelgoed_zelf.title: A Little Bit Guh Too
ftb.guhs_band.q.speelgoed_zelf.desc: Go down the slide yourself, or sneak and right-click the swing or seesaw. Wheee!
ftb.guhs_band.q.speelgoed_alle.title: Playground Wahoog
ftb.guhs_band.q.speelgoed_alle.desc: Have your guhs play with &dall four&r kinds of toys: the nibble ball, the slide, the tunnel and the seesaw or swing. Maybe you'll find their &dfavorite toy&r that way too!
ftb.guhs_band.q.guhkamer_guhbel.title: The Guh Bell
ftb.guhs_band.q.guhkamer_guhbel.desc: Make a &dGuh Bell&r: gold, pink wool and a cheese nibble. Right-click with it: you'll see your guhs nearby and the sleepover guhs in your &dGuh Room&r. Ding-a-ling!
ftb.guhs_band.q.guhkamer_logeren.title: Off to a Sleepover
ftb.guhs_band.q.guhkamer_logeren.desc: Send a guh to the &dGuh Room&r with the Guh Bell: a guest room in your Guhbelly. It waits there safely for you when it can't come along. With the Guh Bell you call it back again, wherever you are.
ftb.guhs_band.q.guhkamer_binnen.title: Sleepover Party
ftb.guhs_band.q.guhkamer_binnen.desc: In your Guhbelly there's a door with a pink curtain and guh ears: walk through it and you're in your &dGuh Room&r. Put Guh Houses and toys in there: they work just like outside.
ftb.guhs_band.q.guhkamer_groei.title: A Room with a View
ftb.guhs_band.q.guhkamer_groei.desc: Your Guh Room grows with every guh that's &6soulguh bff 5evr <3&r: bigger, taller and room for more sleepover guhs.
ftb.guhs_band.q.guhkamer_bezoek.title: Paying a Visit
ftb.guhs_band.q.guhkamer_bezoek.desc: Is a friend's belly public? Then you can go through their Guh Room door too and admire their sleepover guhs. (Only the owner can pet and build.)
ftb.guhs_band.q.samen_juichen.title: Go, Go, WAHOOG!
ftb.guhs_band.q.samen_juichen.desc: Take your guh along to a minigame: shuffleboard, the catapult, golf, fishing, the disco... On a good throw or a fast time it &dcheers&r for you, and on a miss it gets a tiny bit sad in the sweetest way (ooh nyeg...).
ftb.guhs_band.q.samen_gespeeld.title: Played Together
ftb.guhs_band.q.samen_gespeeld.desc: Play a minigame all the way through with your guh nearby. &dPlaying together gives hearts&r, and it goes in its diary!
ftb.guhs_band.q.samen_record.title: A Dance for Your Record
ftb.guhs_band.q.samen_record.desc: Set a new personal record while your guh is watching. It then does the &dSnuggle Dance&r and you both get extra hearts.
ftb.guhs_band.q.samen_kart.title: Hop On the Back!
ftb.guhs_band.q.samen_kart.desc: Start a race on the &dGuh Racetrack&r or the &dGuh Circuit&r with your own guh nearby: it hops &don the back of your kart&r and rides along the whole race. A WAHOOG every lap!
ftb.guhs_band.q.samen_schaatsen.title: Skating Buddies
ftb.guhs_band.q.samen_schaatsen.desc: Skate the &dEleven Guhtowns Tour&r (or just skate around freely) with your guh nearby: it &dskates right beside you&r, just like a Pinguh. Brrr, but snug!
ftb.guhs_band.q.samen_zwemmen.title: Swimming Buddies
ftb.guhs_band.q.samen_zwemmen.desc: Go swimming in the &dSnuggle Pool&r with your guh: it jumps in the water and &dswims along with you&r. Going down a slide? Then it cheers from the side.
ftb.guhs_band.q.samen_welkom.title: Welcome Back!
ftb.guhs_band.q.samen_welkom.desc: Been away for a long time? When you come back your guh does a &dwelcome-back dance&r. It missed you!
ftb.guhs_band.q.samen_troost.title: A Comfort Cuddle
ftb.guhs_band.q.samen_troost.desc: Oops, died? Your guh is already waiting at your &drespawn point&r and gives you a &dcomfort cuddle&r. Nyeg, so glad you're back!
ftb.guhs_band.q.samen_onweer.title: Cuddles in a Thunderstorm
ftb.guhs_band.q.samen_onweer.desc: During a &dthunderstorm&r your guh snuggles up close to you for a cuddle. Not scared, nope, just cozy.
ftb.guhs_band.q.samen_welterusten.title: Good Night!
ftb.guhs_band.q.samen_welterusten.desc: Get into bed with your guhs nearby: they &dwave you good night&r. Sleep chonky-tight!
ftb.guhs_band.q.samen_vriendjes.title: Guh Buddies
ftb.guhs_band.q.samen_vriendjes.desc: Guhs that spend lots of time together become &dbuddies&r: they walk together, cuddle each other, sleep side by side in their house and play together on the seesaw and the swing. Let two guhs become buddies!
See two of your guh buddies give each other a &dcuddle&r. Hearts all around, nyeg!
ftb.guhs_band.q.samen_besties.title: Best Buddies
ftb.guhs_band.q.samen_besties.desc: When two buddies stay together for a long time, they become &dbest buddies&r: a real bff duo. You can see it in the &dGuhdex&r under My Guhs.
ftb.guhs_band.q.samen_speldje.title: A Pin with a Heart
ftb.guhs_band.q.samen_speldje.desc: Become &dsweet chonkies together&r with a guh: all your guhs can now wear the &dHeart Pin&r on their ear, and the &dHearts&r emote (blowing hearts) is yours.
ftb.guhs_band.q.samen_truitje.title: The Snuggle Sweater
ftb.guhs_band.q.samen_truitje.desc: Become &dmega sweet chonkies together&r with a guh: the &dSnuggle Sweater&r and the &dSnuggle Dance&r are yours.
ftb.guhs_band.q.samen_halsbandje.title: The Golden Heart Collar
ftb.guhs_band.q.samen_halsbandje.desc: &6Soulguh bff 5evr <3&r: the &6Soulguh Crown&r and the exclusive &6Golden Heart Collar&r are yours. And your soulguh now has a sparkly heart next to its name!
ftb.guhs_band.q.samen_bff_knuffel.title: BFF Hug
ftb.guhs_band.q.samen_bff_knuffel.desc: Pick the &dBFF Hug&r emote with your soulguh while standing right next to it: you give each other a big hug with a &dbig heart&r above you. Soulguh bff 5evr <3
ftb.guhs_band.q.favorietjes_eerste.title: A Little Secret!
ftb.guhs_band.q.favorietjes_eerste.desc: Every tame guh has &deight secret faves&r: a snack, a spot, a plushie, a song, a toy, a trick, a color and a guh buddy. Try all sorts of things with your guh around. &dCurious&r = warm, &7sniffing... nyeg?&r = cold. Got it? Then comes a big &dheart explosion&r, loads of hearts and a happy guh.
ftb.guhs_band.q.favorietjes_eten.title: Favorite Snack
ftb.guhs_band.q.favorietjes_eten.desc: Every guh has a secret &dfavorite snack&r. Feed your guh all kinds of treats: cupcakes, macarons, ice creams, waffles, sweet berries... Does it look &dcurious&r? Then you're warm (something from the same family). &7Does it sniff... nyeg?&r Then you're cold. The right snack sets off a &dheart explosion&r!
ftb.guhs_band.q.favorietjes_plek.title: Favorite Spot
ftb.guhs_band.q.favorietjes_plek.desc: Take your guh on a trip: every biome you visit together could be its &dfavorite spot&r. Often somewhere in the Guhmension, Snuggledale or the Guh Polder, sometimes a flower forest or a beach. In its favorite spot it's &dhappy&r the whole time!
ftb.guhs_band.q.favorietjes_knuffel.desc: Put plushies down near your guh (the ones from Guh Life): if it goes over to cuddle one, you'll see whether it's its &dfavorite plushie&r. Warm = a plushie from the same family (colors, fairy tales or critters).
ftb.guhs_band.q.favorietjes_liedje.title: Favorite Song
ftb.guhs_band.q.favorietjes_liedje.desc: Play songs on the &dguh xylophone&r or dance in the &dGuh Disco&r with your guh around. The right song makes it sing along at the top of its lungs. After that it hums it at every game and &dcheers louder&r!
ftb.guhs_band.q.favorietjes_speeltje.des: Nibble ball, slide, fluffy tunnel or seesaw & swing: one of them is your guh's &dfavorite toy&r. Let it play and see what happens!
ftb.guhs_band.q.favorietjes_emote.title: Favorite Trick
ftb.guhs_band.q.favorietjes_emote.desc: Have your guh do its tricks (hold right-click on it, &dEmotes&r). One of them is its &dfavorite trick&r. Warm = a trick with the same mood (cheerful or cozy).
ftb.guhs_band.q.favorietjes_kleur.title: Favorite Color
ftb.guhs_band.q.favorietjes_kleur.desc: Dress your guh up in the wardrobe. Every piece of clothing has a color; one color is its &dfavorite color&r. Warm = a neighboring color on the color wheel. Wearing its favorite color, it's happy all day long!
ftb.guhs_band.q.favorietjes_vriend.title: Very Best Guh Buddy
ftb.guhs_band.q.favorietjes_vriend.desc: Got two or more guhs? Then every guh has a &dvery best guh buddy&r. Let them play together and hang out while you're around: with the right buddy it absolutely beams.
ftb.guhs_band.q.favorietjes_juichen.desc: A &dhappy&r guh cheers louder! If you know its favorite song, it brings it along to every game: on a good score or a record it belts it out, with music notes and sparkles.
ftb.guhs_band.q.favorietjes_alle.title: I Know All Your Secrets
ftb.guhs_band.q.favorietjes_alle.desc: Discover &6all eight&r faves of one guh. Its diary (Guhdex, My Guhs) then shows all of them, instead of ???. Soulguh material!
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.verhaal_kompas.title: Once Upon a Guh...
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.verhaal_kompas.desc: Your &6Super Compass&r has a new tab: &dTales&r. Pick a place and follow the needle: Nomguh, Clone Island, the Cloud Chapel, the islands of Guhwai'i or the Carpenter Guh's building site. Every tale ends with a new friend. Nyeg!
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.verhaal_toendra.desc: Somewhere next to the Guh Peaks lies a white, hilly land full of snow: the &fSnowguh Tundra&r. Put on a warm scarf! In the middle of the tundra lies the guh town of &fNomguh&r...
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.verhaal_guhwaii.desc: In the Deep Guh Sea lie tropical islands: &bGuhwai'i&r! Warm sand, a shallow lagoon and palm trees. Aloha, nyeg!
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.verhaal_wolkjes.desc: Sometimes a tame guh goes &dup in the clouds&r for a while. Nyeg... But nothing is ever gone: its &ddiary&r stays in your Guhdex (My Guhs tab), a glowing &dmemory star&r is left behind, and high up in the sky beats the &dSnuggleheart&r, which can bring it back. Tick this off once you know.
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.timmerguh_start.desc: On the edge of every &dSnuggledale town&r (walk all the way down the street past Coco's house: follow the sign) there's a building site. That's where the &6Carpenter Guh&r is building a guh house: a little house shaped like a guh head. Say hello!
The Carpenter Guh needs &616 planks&r (any wood) and &d8 pink wool&r for the ear roof. Bring them to the building site!
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.timmerguh_dak.title: Topping Out!
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.timmerguh_dak.desc: Climb the scaffolding and right-click every see-through spot of the roof with a &droof fluff&r. Don't forget the ears! When the last spot is filled, up goes the flag.
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.timmerguh_bewoner.de: The Carpenter Guh gives you a small &dGuh House&r. Put it down at your home and let one of your tame guhs live in it (right-click the house: New Resident).
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.timmerguh_klaar.desc: Tell the Carpenter Guh: you get his &6building booklet&r! With it you can make all three Guh Houses yourself (the booklet stays in your crafting table). Plus another small house as a gift and a little carpenter's helmet.
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.timmerguh_helmpje.de: A cream-colored little helmet with a pink crest and a heart sticker. Hold it (keep right-click pressed) to unlock it, and dress your guh in it at the wardrobe!
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.timmerguh_knus.title: Cozily Furnished
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.timmerguh_knus.desc: An extra chore from the Carpenter Guh: put a &dtoy&r (slide, seesaw, swing, tunnel or nibble ball) and a &6guh lamp&r in the home area of one of your houses, and tell him.
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.timmerguh_riem.title: Tool Belt
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.timmerguh_riem.desc: The Carpenter Guh's very own tool belt, with a little hammer, a yellow folding ruler and a nail pouch. Tap tap, nyeg!
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.balto_nomguh.title: Nomguh
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.balto_nomguh.desc: In the middle of the &fSnowguh Tundra&r lies &fNomguh&r, a snowy guh town with colorful houses, a little hospital and a sled dog stable. Your &6Super Compass&r (Tales tab) shows the way. Put on a warm scarf, nyeg!
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.balto_ontmoet.title: The Odd One Out
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.balto_ontmoet.desc: By an old boat on the frozen bay sits &7Baltoguh&r: half guh, half wolf. The other guhs think he's weird, and &cSteele Mika&r laughs at him. Say hello!
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.balto_rosy.title: Achoo-Nyeg!
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.balto_rosy.desc: In the &dlittle hospital&r (the white house with the pink heart) the guh babies are all sniffly. &dRosy&r has the nibble cough, and the medicine has run out! The new medicine chest is in the mountain hut on the Nomguh Peaks...
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.balto_boris.title: Da, Little Guh... Honk!
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.balto_boris.desc: &7Boris&r is a real goose (not a guh!) with a fur hat. He knows the way through the storm: follow the &cred poles&r with the little lights. And take Baltoguh along, his nose is the best in Nomguh.
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.balto_tocht.title: Through the Snowstorm
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.balto_tocht.desc: Tell Baltoguh: off to the mountain hut! You steer the snow sled, Baltoguh and the guh sled pups pull. Through Storm Valley, over the Ice Bridge, past Avalanche Mountain, a rest by the fire baskets... and grab the &dmedicine chest&r in the mountain hut.
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.balto_wolf.title: The White Wolf Guh
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.balto_wolf.desc: On the way back the storm is too fierce. Baltoguh has lost the way... Then a white wolf guh appears, and you hear Boris' words. Howl along!
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.balto_held.title: But Maybe... a Baltoguh Can
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.balto_held.desc: Get back to Nomguh in time (Steele Mika wants the credit, of course, nyeh-heh) and bring the medicine chest to Rosy. Everyone in Nomguh will then call you the &6Hero of Nomguh&r! You get your own &fsnow sled&r, the &6Baltoguh Statuette&r and four warm outfits.
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.balto_getemd.title: A Baltoguh of Your Own
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.balto_getemd.desc: After the tale, Baltoguh wants to come home with you (just once, and only for you). In the snow he runs super wahoog fast, even when you ride him.
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.balto_snuffel.title: Sniff Sniff, Home We Go!
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.balto_snuffel.desc: In your Baltoguh's guh menu, press &bSniff!&r: he smells the way to your house (or your bed) and glowing pawprints light up in the snow. Just follow them!
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.balto_beeldje.title: A Hero on a Pedestal
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.balto_beeldje.desc: Put your &6Baltoguh Statuette&r somewhere nice. Click it for the famous words.
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.balto_outfit_sjaaltj: Baltoguh's red scarf, with a little knot and two fluttering ends. A reward for the Hero of Nomguh.
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.balto_outfit_wolfsoo: Pointy gray wolf ears for every guh (on top of the guh ears). A reward for the Hero of Nomguh.
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.balto_outfit_sneeuwm: An ice-blue hat with snowflakes, a big fat pompom and two little braids. A reward for the Hero of Nomguh.
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.balto_outfit_wantjes: Red mittens for the front paws, on a string: never lost again, nyeg! A reward for the Hero of Nomguh.
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.balto_mukluk.title: Muk and Luk
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.balto_mukluk.desc: By the igloo at the little ice pond live two sweet polar bear guhs: &bMuk&r and &aLuk&r. Say hello to both (Luk doesn't say anything back, but cuddles all the more).
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.balto_dex_steele_mik: Add &dSteele Mika&r to your Guhdex (get close).
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.balto_dex_muk.title: Guhdex: Muk
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.balto_dex_luk.title: Guhdex: Luk
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.balto_dex_rosy.title: Guhdex: Rosy
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.balto_dex_witte_wolf: Add &dThe White Wolf Guh&r to your Guhdex (get close, only at the darkest moment of the journey).
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.balto_slee_tocht.des: Rosy and the baby guhs in Nomguh need the medicine! Steer the &bsled&r yourself, with &fBaltoguh&r in the lead: through the snowstorm to the mountain hut and then back to the little hospital in time. &6W&r = hup hup, &6S&r = brake, &6A/D&r = steer. Can't see a thing? Follow Baltoguh's glowing sniff stars.
Along the way there are &6fire baskets&r. Slow down and stop there for a moment: the sled pups warm their paws. Cold paws are slow paws: stop at least once every trek, or they start to dawdle!
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.balto_slee_ijsbrug.d: The &bIce Bridge&r is narrow and slippery: the sled keeps sliding when you steer. Easy does it, and stay in the middle. Fall off? You land in soft snow and get to try again.
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.balto_slee_lawine.de: Rumbling up on the slope? An &favalanche&r! Steer to the &eother side&r of the route before the snow rolls over it. Too late? FLOMP, snowed under: the sled pups dig you out.
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.balto_slee_eigen.des: After the tale of Nomguh you get your &down snow sled&r with four guh sled pups. Put it down on snow and ride 200 blocks through the white tundra (or another snowy land). They only run on snow and ice! A cheese nibble makes them extra happy.
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.balto_slee_sprint_ma: Race against &5Steele Mika&r (at the Nomguh starting line) on &eeasy&r: to the mountain hut, around it and back. Your time goes on the scoreboard and in your Guhdex (Minigames).
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.balto_slee_sprint_me: Race against &5Steele Mika&r (at the Nomguh starting line) on &emedium&r: to the mountain hut, around it and back. Your time goes on the scoreboard and in your Guhdex (Minigames).
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.balto_slee_sprint_la: Race against &5Steele Mika&r (at the Nomguh starting line) on &ehard&r: to the mountain hut, around it and back. Your time goes on the scoreboard and in your Guhdex (Minigames).
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.balto_slee_steele.de: Win the sled sprint against &5Steele Mika&r. He'll probably say it was the wind. All the guhs of Nomguh giggle sweetly.
Win the sled sprint on &chard&r. Then you're the fastest musher in all of Nomguh. Nyeh-heh... er, WAHOOG!
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.balto_slee_winkel.de: Steele Mika has a little shop: a snow guh, a mini sled, sleigh bells, a trail lantern, a sled pup basket and the golden Sled Sprint Cup. Buy the &6sleigh bell arch&r for your sleigh bells.
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.mewtwo_eiland.title: Clone Island
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.mewtwo_eiland.desc: Somewhere in the &9Deep Guh Sea&r stands a rocky island with a glass dome and an arena on top. Find &5Clone Island&r (Super Compass: Tales) and walk up the little jetty.
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.mewtwo_professor.des: In the messy little office next to the dome hall sits &6Professor Nibbleclone&r, his glasses all crooked. Say hello and promise to look for his lab notes.
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.mewtwo_notities.desc: Find the six &6Lab Notes&r: in the little office, in the dome hall, by the clone tank, at the top of the tower stairs and in the boathouse. Read them (right-click) and bring them to the professor. You get the &dTrainer Cap&r!
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.mewtwo_tank.title: Blub, Blub, Fixed!
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.mewtwo_tank.desc: Find the four &6Tank Parts&r in the parts chests (boathouse, little office, tower, stands) and fit them into the cracked &5Clone Tank&r in the dome hall (right-click the tank).
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.mewtwo_mew.title: Hee Hee Hee!
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.mewtwo_mew.desc: Once the tank is bubbling again, someone comes to take a look: &dMewguh&r, a tiny pink floating guh. Add her to your Guhdex! After the tale she always floats around Clone Island.
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.mewtwo_maaltijd.desc: Bring &632 cheese nibbles&r and &62 snacks&r to the big nibble bowl in the arena (right-click the bowl). Guhtwo and Mewguh feast together: x2! You get the Guhtwo Tail and the Little Mewguh Balloon.
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.mewtwo_getemd.title: x2, Nyeg!
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.mewtwo_getemd.desc: Then click the &5Guhtwo&r in the arena and take him home (one per player). He floats, floats over small gaps with you on his back, pulls cheese nibbles within 8 blocks towards himself and eats everything double.
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.mewtwo_telekinese.de: Throw a cheese nibble a few blocks away from your Guhtwo and watch him float it over to himself. (The Telekinesis button in his guh menu turns it on and off.)
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.mewtwo_x2.title: Double Delicious
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.mewtwo_x2.desc: Give your Guhtwo a snack: he feasts x2 and gets double hearts. WAHOOG!
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.mewtwo_petje.title: The Trainer Cap
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.mewtwo_petje.desc: From the professor, for the six lab notes. With our very own logo: the nibble ball with guh ears!
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.mewtwo_pakje.title: The Trainer Outfit
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.mewtwo_pakje.desc: From the professor, once the clone tank is bubbling again: a lilac vest and a little backpack with a nibble ball.
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.mewtwo_staartje.desc: From the Guhtwo, after the big nibble feast: a purple tail with a little bulb and a neck tube.
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.mewtwo_ballonnetje.d: From Mewguh, after the big nibble feast: a pink balloon that looks just like her.
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.hemel_kapelletje.des: High above a small cloud plaza floats an islet with a little cloud temple: the &dCloud Chapel&r. Find it with your Super Compass (&dTales&r tab) and step into the &bCloud Lift&r. Wheee!
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.hemel_hoeder.title: The Cloud Shepherd
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.hemel_hoeder.desc: In the chapel the &fCloud Shepherd&r stands next to the sleeping &dSnuggleheart&r. Talk to him: he'll tell you what the little heart needs.
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.hemel_kristal.title: For the Sparkle
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.hemel_kristal.desc: Bring the Cloud Shepherd a &bguh crystal&r. They glimmer in the crystal caves of the Guhmension.
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.hemel_knabbel.title: For the Warmth
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.hemel_knabbel.desc: Bring the Cloud Shepherd a &6golden cheese nibble&r. They fall from the sky during a Cheese Shower (and sometimes they're in a treasure). Warm and chonky!
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.hemel_veertje.title: For the Softness
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.hemel_veertje.desc: Bring the Cloud Shepherd a &dfluff feather&r. The round Fluff Finches sometimes drop them, in the Guh Fields and the Pink Puffs.
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.hemel_hart.title: Ba-dum, Ba-dum!
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.hemel_hart.desc: With all three things the &dSnuggleheart&r wakes up and beats again. WAHOOG! From now on it brings all your guhs back from the clouds: &afree and unlimited&r.
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.hemel_aureooltje.des: The Cloud Shepherd's thank-you: a &6Golden Halo&r that floats above your guh's head. Hold right-click with it to unlock it.
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.hemel_vleugeltjes.de: And two tiny &fCloud Wings&r for its back. Together with the halo your guh is a real little angel guh!
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.hemel_terug.title: Back from the Clouds
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.hemel_terug.desc: Has one of your tame guhs gone up to the clouds? Click the &dSnuggleheart&r and pick it: it comes back with all its hearts, faves, clothes and its diary. Nobody gets forgotten. Nyeg.
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.hemel_ster.title: A Sweet Little Star
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.hemel_ster.desc: When a tame guh goes up to the clouds, a glowing &dMemory&r star is left behind. Bring it to the Snuggleheart: then the little heart knows right away who you want back.
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.guhwaii_lilo.title: Aloha, Lilo-guh!
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.guhwaii_lilo.desc: On the beach of &bGuhwai'i&r stands a house on stilts. That's where &dLilo-guh&r and her big sister &dNani-guh&r live. Last night Lilo-guh saw a shooting star... Talk to her!
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.guhwaii_capsule.desc: Up on top of the island's hill lies a crashed &bcapsule&r. A crater, smoke, an open hatch... and inside, a strange meter. Who could it belong to?
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.guhwaii_scanner.desc: Inside the capsule stands the &bChonkiness Scanner&r. Put a guh on the plate (or just click: your nearest guh hops on) and watch the &eCHONKINESS LEVEL&r meter: a bit chonky... chonky... very chonky... WAHOOG... &dINCALCULABLY WAHOOG&r! It works on every guh. A guh can never be too chonky!
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.guhwaii_adoptie.desc: Tell Lilo-guh about the capsule. She knows right away who was inside: the little blue guh with four arms from the &aguh shelter&r! She adopts him: from now on his name is &b626-guh&r.
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.guhwaii_opruimen.des: 626-guh has turned the house upside down! Pillow feathers, a knocked-over bucket, coconut shells... It's just a little mess, nothing is broken. Help &dNani-guh&r and click the messy bits away.
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.guhwaii_lief.title: Being Sweet Is Pretty Wahoog
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.guhwaii_lief.desc: 626-guh has to learn to be sweet. Show him how: give him a &6coconut&r, a &dpink hibiscus&r and &e8 cheese nibbles&r (right-click him, at the shelter).
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.guhwaii_ohana.title: Ohana Means Family
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.guhwaii_ohana.desc: Go back to Lilo-guh. &d"Ohana means family. Family means nobody gets left behind... or forgotten. Nyeg."&r You get the poster, a ukulele and the island clothes, and 626-guh can come with you!
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.guhwaii_626.title: Experiment 626, Home!
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.guhwaii_626.desc: Give 626-guh a &echeese nibble&r at the shelter: then he jumps into your arms and comes home with you. Only once per player! He climbs up walls, hangs from the ceiling and carries twice as much on chores.
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.guhwaii_ukelele.desc: Open your 626-guh's guh menu and press &bUkulele&r (or pick the emote): he strums a little song. "Aloha, nyeg!"
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.guhwaii_tokkel.title: Strum Strum
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.guhwaii_tokkel.desc: Play 626-guh's &bspare ukulele&r yourself (right-click): all the guhs around you start dancing!
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.guhwaii_kleding.desc: The &dHula Skirt&r, the &dFlower Lei&r, the &b626 Ears with Antennae&r and the &bsurfboard&r: the clothes of Guhwai'i! Hold right-click with them to unlock them for all your guhs.
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.guhwaii_poster.title: Up on the Wall!
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.guhwaii_poster.desc: Hang up the &dIncalculably Wahoog&r poster. (You can make more: paper, light blue and pink dye and glowstone dust. And there's a big painting of it too!)
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.guhwaii_kokosnoot.de: Under the leaves of a &aGuh Palm&r hang coconuts: green, then yellow, then brown. Pick a brown one (click it) and eat it. Or give it to your guh: guhs love coconut!
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.guhwaii_kokosmelk.de: A coconut and a glass bottle: &fcoconut milk&r! Cool, sweet, and you feel better right away.
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.guhwaii_kiemplant.de: Plant a coconut in sand or on grass: a &aGuh Palm&r grows from it, with a little face in the trunk. Click that face: it winks!
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.guhwaii_hibiscus.des: On Guhwai'i bloom &dpink hibiscus&r, white &fplumeria&r, orange &6birds of paradise&r and purple &5orchids&r. Pick a pink hibiscus!
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.guhwaii_eitjes.title: Crack, Crack!
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.guhwaii_eitjes.desc: In the warm sand lie &aShelly Eggs&r. At night they go faster... crack, crack! Little Poopshellies and Shellies hatch out of them. Wait nearby and watch them hatch!
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.guhwaii_snorkelen.de: Swim in the warm lagoon of Guhwai'i. On the bottom grows a reef of &eCheese Coral&r (near cheese coral you can breathe underwater!), with coral and &dlittle guhfish&r.
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.guhwaii_guhdex.title: Guhdex: Guhwai'i
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.guhwaii_guhdex.desc: Add &b626-guh&r, &dLilo-guh&r and &dNani-guh&r to your Guhdex (just get close).
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.guhwaii_spellen_stra: On the beach of a &dGuhwai'i&r island there's sometimes a sunny surf beach: a round hula stage with torches, &6Lilo-guh&r by her surf hut and &6Tiki Guh&r behind his Tiki stand (Super Compass: Tales or Minigames).
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.guhwaii_spellen_tiki: Add &6Tiki Guh&r to your Guhdex (get close enough). What would he look like without his mask?
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.guhwaii_spellen_surf: Surf with Lilo-guh on &aeasy&r: little waves that you catch all by yourself. Stay ahead of the foam!
Surf on &emedium&r: paddle into the wave with &6W&r when it reaches you. Pump with W and S for speed!
Surf on &chard&r: big, fast waves that break quickly. Land your tricks straight!
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.guhwaii_spellen_knab: Jump off the crest of a wave with &6space&r (with enough speed) and spin a full circle with &6A/D&r before you land. Grab your board with &6S&r for extra points!
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.guhwaii_spellen_tube: On medium and hard the wave curls over next to the foam: stay high on the wave, just ahead of the foam, and surf through the &dtube&r!
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.guhwaii_spellen_hula: Dance the hula to &aAloha, Nyeg&r: a slow moonlight song, just your hips (&6A&r and &6D&r).
Dance to &eGuhla-Hula Rock&r: hips, arms up (&6W&r) and bend your knees (&6S&r), to the beat of the rock'n'roll!
Dance to &cWahoog Hula Hop&r: fast, with half beats, and &6space&r on the golden WAHOOG! stars.
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.guhwaii_spellen_fout: Dance a whole song on medium or hard without missing a single step. Lilo-guh cries happy tears!
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.guhwaii_spellen_alle: Surf and dance on all three levels: six rows in the Minigames tab of your Guhdex.
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.guhwaii_spellen_sche: Save up 20 &dSeashell Coins&r. They jingle so cozily!
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.guhwaii_spellen_tiki: Buy something pretty from &6Tiki Guh&r: torches, masks, a tiki statue, thatched roofs, flower garlands, seashell lanterns...
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.guhwaii_spellen_radi: Buy the &6Tiki Radio&r (10 Seashell Coins). Right-click: the hula songs of Guhwai'i play, even at home!
ftb.guhs_diertjes.title: &aCritters of the Guhmension
This chapter comes after &dWelcome to the Guhmension!&r in &dThe Guhmension&r.

The Guhmension is full of sweet critters: birdies in the trees and above the sea, guhxolotls and ducklings in the ponds, butterflies and glowguhs above the flowers, and hedgehogs, bunnies and squirrels in the grass. Not guhs, but very guh-ish! And somewhere, very slowly... Shuckly.

Get close to add them to your &dGuhdex&r: they all count towards &6everything collected&r. Some of them you can even tame and pick up. Nothing is locked: every quest ticks itself off as soon as you've done it, even if you did it before. The headings show what logically comes next. Tick this off and get chonking!
ftb.guhs_diertjes.q.vogels_pluisvinkje.d: In the &dGuh Fields&r, the &dPink Puffs&r and the Guh Meadows, little flocks of &dFluff Finches&r flutter around the guh blossom trees. Creep closer (&7sneak&r!), or the whole flock flies off. Add one to your Guhdex.
Fluff Finches sometimes drop a &dfluff feather&r, especially when you give them &eseeds&r. The Cloud Shepherd of the Cloud Chapel is looking for one!
ftb.guhs_diertjes.q.vogels_kaasmeesje.de: In the &2Chonkwood Forest&r and the &eCheese Flats&r live &eCheese Chickadees&r: yellow, with a cheese stripe on their tummy. Add one to your Guhdex.
ftb.guhs_diertjes.q.vogels_ondersteboven: Cheese Chickadees love hanging &eupside down&r under the leaves. Take a look up in the forest!
ftb.guhs_diertjes.q.vogels_guh_uiltje.de: During the day the &6Guh Owlet&r sleeps on a branch in the &7Guh Peaks&r or the &2Chonkwood Forest&r. At night its little eyes start to glow. Add one to your Guhdex.
ftb.guhs_diertjes.q.vogels_oehoe.title: Hoo-hoo... Nyeg!
ftb.guhs_diertjes.q.vogels_oehoe.desc: Head out at night and listen: can you hear a &6Guh Owlet&r calling? Its little head turns all the way around to look at you!
ftb.guhs_diertjes.q.vogels_zeemeeuwtje.d: Along the &bGuh Sea&r, the &9Deep Guh Sea&r and on &dGuhwai'i&r, &fSeagulls&r sit on the beach or bob on the waves. Add one to your Guhdex.
ftb.guhs_diertjes.q.vogels_mijn.title: Mine! Mine!
ftb.guhs_diertjes.q.vogels_mijn.desc: Hold a &bfish&r (or bread) near the seagulls. What do they shout then? Give one of them a fish and it's the happiest gull of the Guh Sea.
ftb.guhs_diertjes.q.vogels_voerhuisje.de: Make a &dbird feeder&r and put seeds on it (right-click). All the birdies nearby come to feast, and fluff finches sometimes leave a fluff feather behind!
ftb.guhs_diertjes.q.vogels_sluipen.title: Shh, Easy Now...
ftb.guhs_diertjes.q.vogels_sluipen.desc: Birdies get startled when you come stomping over. &7Sneak&r right up to a sitting birdie without it flying away.
ftb.guhs_diertjes.q.vogels_alle.title: Birdwatcher
ftb.guhs_diertjes.q.vogels_alle.desc: Add &dall four&r birdies of the Guhmension to your Guhdex: the fluff finch, the cheese chickadee, the guh owlet and the seagull. Tweet-nyeg!
ftb.guhs_diertjes.q.waterdiertjes_guhxol: In the shallow water of the &bGuh Sea&r and the &eCheese Swamp&r swim &dguhxolotls&r: guhs that are axolotls, with fluffy little gills. Swim up close for your Guhdex!
ftb.guhs_diertjes.q.waterdiertjes_temmen: Give a guhxolotl a &6little guhfish&r (1 in 3 chance). Once tamed it follows you through water and over land, and clicking it opens its little menu.
ftb.guhs_diertjes.q.waterdiertjes_emmert: Scoop up a guhxolotl with a &bwater bucket&r (or sneak-click your own guhxolotl with an empty hand). Put it down wherever you like: splash! It can live in a guh house too, where it never dries out.
ftb.guhs_diertjes.q.waterdiertjes_blubbe: Press &bBubblies!&r in your guhxolotl's little menu: it blows a cloud of bubbles around you and you can breathe underwater for two minutes.
ftb.guhs_diertjes.q.waterdiertjes_goud.d: Every once in a while a guhxolotl is &6GOLD&r, with sparkly speckles. See one up close (or breed one: babies are sometimes gold!).
ftb.guhs_diertjes.q.waterdiertjes_alle_k: Tame a &dpink&r, a &amint&r, a &6choco&r, a &fwhite&r and a &egolden&r guhxolotl. What a WAHOOG collection!
ftb.guhs_diertjes.q.waterdiertjes_eendje: On ponds and along the Guh Sea, &fGuh Ducklings&r paddle around. Get close for your Guhdex!
ftb.guhs_diertjes.q.waterdiertjes_rijtje: A mama duck has a little row of &efluffy chicks&r trailing behind her: each chick follows the one in front. Spot one with at least three chicks!
ftb.guhs_diertjes.q.waterdiertjes_vlinde: During the day &enibble butterflies&r flutter from flower to flower. Walk up to them gently (no running!) for your Guhdex.
ftb.guhs_diertjes.q.waterdiertjes_glimgu: When it's dark, &aglowguhs&r float above the Cheese Swamp and the Guh Meadows: teeny-tiny guhs with a little light in their tummy.
ftb.guhs_diertjes.q.waterdiertjes_lieveh: A &cladybug&r with little guh heads for spots! You'll find them near flowers and by your guh gardens.
ftb.guhs_diertjes.q.waterdiertjes_tuinhu: Got a guh garden with something growing in it? Then sometimes a ladybug lands on it, and then it grows a &atiny bit faster&r. Watch it happen!
ftb.guhs_diertjes.q.landdiertjes_egeltje: In the &2Chonkwood Forest&r, &dfluffhogs&r potter about: hedgehogs with soft cuddle spines. Don't walk straight at them, or they'll roll up into a ball! Sneak closer (within 3 blocks) so it goes into your Guhdex.
Sneak up to a fluffhog and give it &csweet berries&r. Sometimes it eats from your hand and it's yours! Once tamed: right-click with an empty hand for its little menu, and try &dRoll Up!&r.
ftb.guhs_diertjes.q.landdiertjes_konijnt: In the &aGuh Meadows&r, &dguh bunnies&r with long floppy ears hop around: pink, white, choco and gray (and in the Snowguh Tundra they're all white!). Get close for your Guhdex.
Tame a guh bunny with a &6carrot&r (or a cheese nibble). Once tamed it can do a happy &dbinky&r: then you get a few bunny hops too!
ftb.guhs_diertjes.q.landdiertjes_eekhoor: In the &dguh blossom trees&r and the &2Chonkwood Forest&r live &6fluff squirrels&r with an enormous curly tail. They climb up tree trunks! Get close for your Guhdex.
Tame a fluff squirrel with &6cheese nibbles&r. Whatever it had stuffed in its cheeks, you get as a gift!
ftb.guhs_diertjes.q.landdiertjes_schoude: Pick &dOn my shoulder!&r in your squirrel's little menu (or pick it up and right-click into the air with it): it sits on your shoulder! Sneak + right-click a block with an empty hand, and it hops off.
ftb.guhs_diertjes.q.landdiertjes_voorraa: Squirrels hide cheese nibbles in &6little dirt mounds&r (with a nibble peeking out). Find one and right-click to dig it up. A tame squirrel digs one up for you every now and then!
ftb.guhs_diertjes.q.landdiertjes_shuckle: Not a guh! A &cred shell with cheese holes&r and a &eyellow little head&r. Shuckly lives around the rocks of &dClone Island&r in the Guh Sea, and once in a blue moon deep in the &6Holey Cheese Caves&r. He's very shy: sneak!
Sneak up to Shuckly (or he'll crawl into his shell) and give him &csweet berries&r. It takes a while... he's just very slow. Once tamed he follows you, at his own pace.
ftb.guhs_diertjes.q.landdiertjes_sapje.d: Give your tame Shuckly sweet berries: he keeps them in his shell. With 3 berries he turns them into &dberry juice&r all by himself (or pick &dBerry Juice!&r in his little menu). Cheers, nyeg!
ftb.guhs_diertjes.q.landdiertjes_polijst: Let your Shuckly live in a &dguh house&r and put &7cobblestone&r in the chest next to it. His chore: very patiently polishing stones into &fsmooth stone&r and shiny &dguh pebbles&r (four of those make a guh pebble path).
Hedgehogs, bunnies, squirrels and Shuckly can also live in a &dguh house&r: use your picked-up critter on the house, or pick it in the house screen.
ftb.guhs_diertjes.q.landdiertjes_alle.de: Tame them all: a fluffhog, a guh bunny, a fluff squirrel and a Shuckly. WAHOOG!
ftb.guhs_band.q.wilde_guhweerder.title: A Chonky Lives Here Already
ftb.guhs_band.q.wilde_guhweerder.desc: Put a &dWild Guh Shoo-Sign&r in your house or base (pink wool, a cheese nibble and a stick). Wild guhs see the sign and know: a chonky lives here already! So they sweetly go cuddle somewhere else. Right-click the sign to choose the area and show it as a &9blue dome&r. Your own guhs are welcome to stay.
ftb.guhs_band.q.huisje_binnen.title: Have a Look Inside
ftb.guhs_band.q.huisje_binnen.desc: Right-click a Guh House and click &dGo inside&r. Ding-dong! Inside, everything is guh-sized, so you are suddenly very big. Every resident has its own little bed with a name sign, its favourite thing on the bedside table and its clothes on the hook. At night they lie there snoring; if a bed is empty, a note says where your guh is. In your own house you can &dtuck sleepers in&r and pet them softly, click a bed for the diary and read the notice board. In the &dguest bed&r you sleep through the night yourself. The door takes you back outside.
